components.name: Accumulation strength
components.detail: Net smart-money broker buys minus retail/distributor sells, normalized for liquidity. Capped at 50 to reward sustained accumulation, not single-day spikes.

components.name: Regime confidence
components.detail: Regime derived from 5-day volume-weighted price action. Confidence = how many days align with the regime. DISTRIBUTION and NEUTRAL score 0.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.name: Foreign alignment
components.detail: Foreign money is long-term smart money. Aligned with local accumulation = double-confirmation.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.

components.name: Technical setup
components.formula: (Bullish OR Strong Bullish EMA) AND RSI < 70 → 5
components.detail: EMA trend uses 20/50/200-day EMAs. Strong Bullish = price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Bullish = price > EMA20. Overbought (RSI-14 ≥ 70) kills the bonus.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.name: Foreign alignment
components.detail: Foreign money is long-term smart money. Aligned with local accumulation = double-confirmation.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.

components.formula: (Bullish OR Strong Bullish EMA) AND RSI < 70 → 5

components.detail: EMA trend uses 20/50/200-day EMAs. Strong Bullish = price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Bullish = price > EMA20. Overbought (RSI-14 ≥ 70) kills the bonus.

components.name: Accumulation strength
components.detail: Net smart-money broker buys minus retail/distributor sells, normalized for liquidity. Capped at 50 to reward sustained accumulation, not single-day spikes.

components.name: Regime confidence
components.detail: Regime derived from 5-day volume-weighted price action. Confidence = how many days align with the regime. DISTRIBUTION and NEUTRAL score 0.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.name: Foreign alignment
components.detail: Foreign money is long-term smart money. Aligned with local accumulation = double-confirmation.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.

components.name: Technical setup
components.formula: (Bullish OR Strong Bullish EMA) AND RSI < 70 → 5
components.detail: EMA trend uses 20/50/200-day EMAs. Strong Bullish = price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Bullish = price > EMA20. Overbought (RSI-14 ≥ 70) kills the bonus.

penalties.name: Low liquidity
penalties.detail: Avg 20d value < 1B IDR/day — hard to exit without slippage.

components.name: Accumulation strength
components.detail: Net smart-money broker buys minus retail/distributor sells, normalized for liquidity. Capped at 50 to reward sustained accumulation, not single-day spikes.

components.name: Regime confidence
components.detail: Regime derived from 5-day volume-weighted price action. Confidence = how many days align with the regime. DISTRIBUTION and NEUTRAL score 0.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.detail: EMA trend uses 20/50/200-day EMAs. Strong Bullish = price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Bullish = price > EMA20. Overbought (RSI-14 ≥ 70) kills the bonus.

components.name: Accumulation strength
components.detail: Net smart-money broker buys minus retail/distributor sells, normalized for liquidity. Capped at 50 to reward sustained accumulation, not single-day spikes.

components.name: Regime confidence
components.detail: Regime derived from 5-day volume-weighted price action. Confidence = how many days align with the regime. DISTRIBUTION and NEUTRAL score 0.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.name: Foreign alignment
components.detail: Foreign money is long-term smart money. Aligned with local accumulation = double-confirmation.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.

components.detail: EMA trend uses 20/50/200-day EMAs. Strong Bullish = price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Bullish = price > EMA20. Overbought (RSI-14 ≥ 70) kills the bonus.

components.name: Accumulation strength
components.detail: Net smart-money broker buys minus retail/distributor sells, normalized for liquidity. Capped at 50 to reward sustained accumulation, not single-day spikes.

components.name: Regime confidence
components.detail: Regime derived from 5-day volume-weighted price action. Confidence = how many days align with the regime. DISTRIBUTION and NEUTRAL score 0.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.name: Foreign alignment
components.detail: Foreign money is long-term smart money. Aligned with local accumulation = double-confirmation.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.

components.detail: EMA trend uses 20/50/200-day EMAs. Strong Bullish = price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Bullish = price > EMA20. Overbought (RSI-14 ≥ 70) kills the bonus.

penalties.name: Low liquidity
penalties.detail: Avg 20d value < 1B IDR/day — hard to exit without slippage.

components.name: Accumulation strength
components.detail: Net smart-money broker buys minus retail/distributor sells, normalized for liquidity. Capped at 50 to reward sustained accumulation, not single-day spikes.

components.name: Regime confidence
components.detail: Regime derived from 5-day volume-weighted price action. Confidence = how many days align with the regime. DISTRIBUTION and NEUTRAL score 0.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.name: Foreign alignment
components.detail: Foreign money is long-term smart money. Aligned with local accumulation = double-confirmation.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.

components.detail: EMA trend uses 20/50/200-day EMAs. Strong Bullish = price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Bullish = price > EMA20. Overbought (RSI-14 ≥ 70) kills the bonus.

penalties.name: Low liquidity
penalties.detail: Avg 20d value < 1B IDR/day — hard to exit without slippage.

components.name: Accumulation strength
components.detail: Net smart-money broker buys minus retail/distributor sells, normalized for liquidity. Capped at 50 to reward sustained accumulation, not single-day spikes.

components.name: Regime confidence
components.detail: Regime derived from 5-day volume-weighted price action. Confidence = how many days align with the regime. DISTRIBUTION and NEUTRAL score 0.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.name: Foreign alignment
components.detail: Foreign money is long-term smart money. Aligned with local accumulation = double-confirmation.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.

components.detail: EMA trend uses 20/50/200-day EMAs. Strong Bullish = price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Bullish = price > EMA20. Overbought (RSI-14 ≥ 70) kills the bonus.

penalties.name: Low liquidity
penalties.detail: Avg 20d value < 1B IDR/day — hard to exit without slippage.

components.name: Accumulation strength
components.detail: Net smart-money broker buys minus retail/distributor sells, normalized for liquidity. Capped at 50 to reward sustained accumulation, not single-day spikes.

components.name: Regime confidence
components.detail: Regime derived from 5-day volume-weighted price action. Confidence = how many days align with the regime. DISTRIBUTION and NEUTRAL score 0.

components.name: Persistence
components.detail: Consecutive days the regime held. 1-day = noise; 5+ days = pattern. Resets when regime flips.

components.name: Silent buying
components.detail: Price barely moves (stab = 7d close volatility) while traded value spikes vs 7d average → hidden demand absorbing supply. Low-liquidity disqualifies.

components.name: Foreign alignment
components.detail: Foreign money is long-term smart money. Aligned with local accumulation = double-confirmation.

components.name: Associate broker
components.detail: Lead IPO underwriter buying back into the stock — rare and insider-adjacent. Amplified when stock is still in its post-IPO settling period.
